 Meteorologist: Russell Thomas

 We'll see a partly cloudy sky with a stray shower this evening. High dew points will bring a muggy feel with temperatures falling into the upper 70s by late evening. Expect a mostly clear sky overnight with morning lows in the lower to middle 70s. Humid conditions will be a theme over the next several mornings.
 Friday: Our warm, humid start to the day will transition to a very warm, muggy afternoon. Mid-afternoon temperatures will climb into the middle to upper 80s however, when you factor in the high dew point values, our feels like temperatures will range from the lower to middle 90s. Expect a good deal of sunshine to come with those high heat index numbers. While we can't rule out a shower or two, most locations will be dry with a mostly sunny late afternoon and evening.
 Halloween weekend:  We don't have a lot of change in our weekend forecast. Saturday will be warm and muggy under a partly to mostly cloudy sky. Rain chances will increase to roughly 40% by the afternoon hours, and we can't rule out a thunderstorm or two. The good news for trick-or-treaters is I expect shower chances to diminish as we head into the evening hours. It will be a good idea to have an umbrella on the ready, but most will not have to use them. Expect highs in the middle to upper 80s.  Sunday will bring a better chance of widespread rain, with heavy showers possible at times. Much like Saturday, a thunderstorm or two is possible on Sunday. Overall, plan for a warm, humid, wet day with highs reaching the lower to middle 80s.
 Monday - Friday: Rain chances will continue into Monday afternoon before decreasing during the evening hours. Rain will not be as widespread as Sunday, though we are expecting a 40% chance of rain across the region. We'll start the day in the lower 70s before warming into the mid 80s during he afternoon. Once again, humidity values will be high. Tuesday and Wednesday will bring sun and clouds with highs in the middle 80s and lows in the upper 60s.  Scattered showers look more likely on Thursday with drier and cooler conditions expected on Friday.
 The tropics are looking quiet over the next 7 days.
